name: Pål Andrestuen
description: A charming tenant renting the back part of the house, secretly involved with the wife and easily rattled when threatened.
visualPrompt: Young Scandinavian man in a casual hoodie and work boots, tense posture and wide eyes, mid-sprint near a backyard fence and tool shed, wind-tossed hair, modern suburban setting

name: The Wife
description: Married to a kind deaf man but drawn to the tenant, she tries to keep the affair quiet until she’s cornered into shouting the truth.
visualPrompt: Scandinavian woman in her 30s–40s wearing a practical modern coat over casual clothes, flushed face and furious, frightened expression, clutching a bundled lunch under her jacket, caught in motion in a muddy yard

name: The Deaf Husband
description: A decent, trusting man who follows along with what he’s told, unaware he’s being used as a prop in the teen’s scheme.
visualPrompt: Middle-aged Scandinavian man with sturdy build, wearing workwear and gloves, calm but puzzled expression, holding a wood-splitting axe for chores, standing near a garage or stacked firewood in a modern yard

name: The Handyman Boy
description: A clever teen who notices the affair and turns it into a wager, engineering perfectly timed distractions and rumors to force a public confession.
visualPrompt: Teen boy in a zip-up jacket and jeans with a sly, calculating look, standing casually near a garage doorway, one hand in pocket, watching events unfold in a contemporary suburban home setting
